task: verify R18NL-3 (N2 longer/stronger distilled secondary FT pair, conditional on an exp72 UP)
reason: VALUE: (1) N2 is dominated by N1, the CPU-only theta0 + 2*(theta_ft - theta0) rung. Both test the same 'more dose of the exp71 direction' hypothesis, and only one of them gets a slot. N2 adds ~3.5 GPU-h, a new user OK and a GPU-lane collision, and gives almost no information N1 would not. Its N1-vs-N2 selection rule ('dummy node delta closest to 2x exp72's -0.16%') is not a quality signal: CONTEXT records the node gate as necessary-only, and exp23 was +0.62% nodes yet -0.007. (2) The trigger almost never fires honestly. exp71 is a tiny nudge (rel L2 0.3-4.4%; the detect_head bias is cancelled by x138's per-frame mean/std alignment; proxy 0.995/1.007; dummy nodes -0.16%), so exp72 most likely displays 0.954. An 'attributable UP' at a 3-decimal display on one public embryo (~29% of test) has low power, and when it fires it is mostly noise. Escalating the dose on that read is a public knob ladder with no honest lab gate: G2 on held-out 6bba was never run, so any private value is unmeasured. (3) The evidence points the wrong way. The retrain family is 0/5 on our LB (-0.016, -0.025, -0.007, -0.003, -0.004), imissher's more-adapted secondary was -0.008 (discussion 743222), and v_retrain.json already ruled RT-6 NO-GO because more drift raises peak confidence and nodes. (4) Q3 is unanswered, so any N2 output is public-only and adds nothing to the private finals. FEASIBILITY: (a) 'Continue from ed8c616b with the same recipe' is not verbatim. Per r_retrain RT-1, the y3uanm trainer subclass re-inits from initial_state and builds the teacher from it. Loading ed8c616b as the initial state would make the teacher ed8c616b, a moving and weaker anchor, unless new code pins the teacher to 9bac2fa0. The AdamW moments were not saved either. (b) One T4x2 session holds a GPU lane from ~08:15 to ~11:30Z 28 Sep, exactly when the exp75/exp74/exp73 dummies need lanes. On 27 Sep the exp75 dummy sat QUEUED for more than 1.3 h and lost its slot for that reason. (c) It needs a new user OK beyond Q1, and it runs against 'no retraining before 29 Sep' (lifted only for exp71/exp72). Unconditional P(+0.002) is ~0.05 at best; the realistic EV is ~0 and below N1's at a much higher cost.
fix: Drop N2 and put it on the post-deadline list (a multi-epoch distilled FT, gated on a held-out 6bba lab, with the teacher pinned explicitly to 9bac2fa0). If exp72 shows an attributable UP, use only the free N1 extrapolation rung, with a pre-registered dummy that checks the node delta against exp72's. Keep 28 Sep GPU lanes free for the exp75/exp74/exp73 dummies. If the user still wants N2, it needs (i) a code change that pins the teacher to 9bac2fa0 when the student starts from ed8c616b, plus a sanity assert, (ii) a Settings-page quota read of >= 10 GPU-h before the push, and (iii) an explicit user OK logged in CONTEXT before the exp72 score lands.
realistic_gain: ~0 public (central ~+0.0000 to +0.0005 given an exp72 UP; the unconditional expectation is below N1's); P(display >= 0.956) <= ~0.05; private value unmeasured, and it could be negative (the drift direction lost -0.007/-0.008 before); cost ~3.5 GPU-h + one slot + a blocked GPU lane on 28 Sep morning.
